rules.description: Checks date freshness across 2022, 2010, 2000, and 1940 literacy StatVar cohorts.

params.query: SELECT StatVar, MaxDate, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_svs FROM stats
params.condition: ((StatVar IN ('Count_Person_15OrMoreYears', 'Count_Person_15OrMoreYears_Male', 'Count_Person_15OrMoreYears_Female', 'Count_Person_15OrMoreYears_Literate', 'Count_Person_15OrMoreYears_Male_Literate', 'Count_Person_15OrMoreYears_Female_Literate', 'Count_Person_15OrMoreYears_Illiterate', 'Count_Person_15OrMoreYears_Male_Illiterate', 'Count_Person_15OrMoreYears_Female_Illiterate') AND MaxDate >= '2022') OR (StatVar LIKE '%Illiterate_AsAFractionOf%' AND MaxDate >= '2010') OR (StatVar LIKE '%Literate_AsAFractionOf%' AND MaxDate >= '2000') OR (StatVar NOT IN ('Count_Person_15OrMoreYears', 'Count_Person_15OrMoreYears_Male', 'Count_Person_15OrMoreYears_Female', 'Count_Person_15OrMoreYears_Literate', 'Count_Person_15OrMoreYears_Male_Literate', 'Count_Person_15OrMoreYears_Female_Literate', 'Count_Person_15OrMoreYears_Illiterate', 'Count_Person_15OrMoreYears_Male_Illiterate', 'Count_Person_15OrMoreYears_Female_Illiterate') AND StatVar NOT LIKE '%_AsAFractionOf_%' AND MaxDate >= '1940')) AND total_svs > 0

rules.description: Checks date consistency across active 2022 15+ literacy StatVars.
Checks that every literacy StatVar covers at least 33 places.
